s: Carrying the brand — and the performance — of the famous auto body filler, Bondo® Original Filler is formulated for a tremendous range of auto and home repairs requiring a permanent, fast-curing, limited-drip formula. This all-purpose filler is great for filling small holes or scratches, but it is also very strong for rebuilding rotted or missing pieces of the original surface. Bondo® Original Filler is formulated slightly thicker than some other fillers, making it easier to apply to vertical surfaces such as door jambs or walls where dripping and running are concerns.
